items.headline: Iran ka Bahrain me US thikanon par hamla
items.detail: IRGC ne dava kiya usne Bahrain ki al-Riffa aur Awali bases par do US Patriot radar nishana banaye; Bahrain ne kaha uski vayu raksha ne hamle roke, ek audyogik jagah par aag lagi, koi ghayal nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Iran-America yuddh, Bahrain, US Fifth Fleet — UPSC IR

items.headline: Poland me Russian missile gira, NATO naraz
items.detail: Ukraine par raat ke hamle ke dauran do Russian missile aur ek drone Poland me gire; PM Tusk ne ise jaanboojh kar uksava bataya, NATO pramukh Rutte ne ise gambhir ullanghan kaha, koi ghayal nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Poland, NATO, Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Peru ke Andes me 6.7 ka bhukamp
items.detail: Junin ke paas shaam 7:09 baje bhukamp aaya, jhatke Lima tak mehsoos hue; USGS ke anusar teevrata 6.7 aur gehrai 108 km thi, koi maut ya bada nuksan nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Bhukamp, Ring of Fire — UPSC Geography

items.headline: Russia ka Ukraine par bada hamla, aath mare
items.detail: Russia ne raat bhar 400 se zyada drone aur 110 se zyada missile daage, Kyiv ke Dnipro pul aur bijli-rail dhwast hue; aath log mare gaye, chhah Kyiv me.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Kerch Bridge — UPSC IR

items.headline: Mexico ne FBI-wanted 'El Chapo Isidro' pakda
items.detail: Sinaloa ke Guasave me sena ne FBI ki 10 most-wanted list wale Fausto Isidro Meza Flores ko giraftar kiya; giraftari ke baad hui hinsa me 11 log mare gaye — saat sandigdh bandukdhari aur chaar sainik.
items.exam_angle: Mexico, drug cartel, FBI most-wanted — UPSC IR

items.headline: Houthi missile Riyadh par, Saudi ne roke
items.detail: Saudi gathbandhan ne Riyadh ki taraf aaye teen Houthi ballistic missile roke; Houthi ne Hodeidah hamle ka badla lene ki baat kahi.
items.exam_angle: Yemen-Saudi sangharsh, Red Sea suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Myanmar ne ICJ faisla thukraya, France UNSC jayega
items.detail: France ne kaha woh UN Security Council ki baithak mangega, kyunki Myanmar ne Rohingya narasanhar par ICJ ke faisle ko manne se inkar kar diya.
items.exam_angle: ICJ faisla, Rohingya sankat — antarrashtriya kanoon

items.headline: Basra power station me aag, chaar ki maut
items.detail: Hartha power station me gas pipeline me aag lagi, kam se kam chaar mare aur tees ghayal; toll badhne ki aashanka hai.

items.headline: FBI aur USDA par hacker hamla
items.detail: CNN ke mutabik FBI ke National Crime Information Center database me ghuspaith ki jaanch chal rahi hai; NBC ke mutabik USDA ke kisan-bhugtan system par bhi cyber hamla hua — dono ka sambandh aur zimmedar abhi agyaat hai.
items.exam_angle: America ki cyber suraksha, NCIC database — UPSC Science & Tech

items.headline: Trump, Xi, Putin ki shanti ghoshna
items.detail: Shenzhen me pehli baar teen bade netaon ne 'Declaration toward Peace' jaari ki — parmanu yuddh kabhi nahi ladna chahiye, UN sudhar, tel aapoorti aur ICC par sahmati; Ukraine aur Iran ka zikr nahi, koi samay-seema nahi.
items.exam_angle: US-China-Russia, APEC, parmanu hathiyar — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: The White House, Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

items.headline: Qatar ne Tehran me vaarta ki
items.detail: Iran ke up-mantri ne kaha Qatar ka pratinidhimandal pichhli shaam Tehran aaya aur do ghante vaarta ki; yuddh khatm karne ki baatchit abhi atki hui hai.
items.exam_angle: West Asia kootniti, Qatar madhyasthata — UPSC IR

items.headline: Anthropic ka $93.5 billion record IPO
items.detail: AI company Anthropic ka IPO itihas ka sabse bada ban gaya — $93.5 billion jama, SpaceX ka $86 billion ka record toota; share pehle din 17% chadha, agle din 9.5% gira.
items.exam_angle: Sabse bada IPO, AI economy — UPSC Economy

items.headline: Zelensky: Crimean Bridge hamla 'fair response'
items.detail: Zelensky ne kaha Crimean Bridge par hamla Russia ke 109 pul-hamlon ka 'fair response' tha — pul ka beech wala hissa samundar me gira, gaadiyon ke liye band; UK ke raksha mantri ne Kyiv me samarthan jataya.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh, Crimean Bridge — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump ne Iran faisla agle saal tak taala
items.detail: Trump ne kaha Iran par naye hamlo ka faisla 'saal ki shuruaat ke baad' hoga — Reuters se 'We've got time', Fox ko '1 January ke baad dekhenge'; Senate ne yuddh rokne wala prastav phir kharij kiya.
items.exam_angle: US-Iran tanaav, West Asia — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: The White House, Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

items.headline: Nigeria: janaze wali naav palti, 24 mare
items.detail: Bayelsa me Ayama se Ukubie ja rahi bheed-bhaad wali naav shukravar ko palat gayi; NEMA ke mutabik 24 shav mile, 24 log bachaye gaye, talash jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Nigeria, aapda prabandhan — UPSC Geography

items.headline: NATO: Poland ki har inch zameen ki raksha
items.detail: NATO pramukh Rutte ne Warsaw me kaha woh Poland ki har inch zameen ki raksha ki guarantee dete hain; NATO parishad somvar ko ullanghan par baithak karegi.
items.exam_angle: NATO, Poland, Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Iran: Hormuz khul sakta hai, shartein manzoor hon
items.detail: Videsh mantri Araghchi ne kaha America 'uchit shartein' mane to Hormuz kholna mushkil nahi; up-mantri ne Americi naakaabandi ko 'shatrutapoorn' bataya.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz, Iran-America, tel vyapar — UPSC IR

items.headline: China ne US telecom pratibandh ka virodh kiya
items.detail: China ke vanijya mantralaya ne FCC ke faisle ka virodh kiya — China Mobile, China Telecom aur China Unicom ko US phone number se roka gaya; jawabi kadam ki chetavni di.
items.exam_angle: US-China, telecom, rashtriya suraksha — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Baltic me Russian jahaz par drone hamla, aag
items.detail: Finland ki khadi me Kaliningrad ja raha Sparta II drone hamle ke baad jal utha; 16 sadasyiya dal ko nikala gaya, Finland ko Ukraine par shak hai.
items.exam_angle: Baltic, Finland, Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gaza: khane wali gaadi par hamla, teen mare
items.detail: Gaza City ke Tel al-Hawa me khana pahuncha rahi gaadi par Israeli hamle me teen log mare gaye; Israel ne kaha woh Islamic Jihad ke ladake the, Hamas ne madhyasthon ki turant baithak mangi.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhaviram, Israel-Hamas — UPSC IR

items.headline: France me chhathe hafte bhi bada pradarshan
items.detail: Mehngai aur kharab sarkari sevayon ke khilaf France bhar me chhathe hafte pradarshan hue; grih mantralaya ke mutabik 82,500 log shamil hue, 144 giraftar, kai jagah aansu gas chali.

items.headline: Iran me bijli rationing, ravivaar se katoti
items.detail: Yuddh se urja dhacha kshatigrast hone par Iran ne ravivaar se rolling power cut ki ghoshna ki — ilaake ke hisab se har do din me ya roz do ghante tak bijli band rahegi.
items.exam_angle: Iran urja sankat, yuddh ka asar — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Mecca kshetra me alert, missile roka gaya
items.detail: Shanivaar raat Houthi missile paschimi Saudi ki taraf aaya to Mecca prant me khatre ka alert jaari hua, thodi der me hata liya gaya; gathbandhan ne missile roka, Houthi ne Mecca ko nishana banane se inkar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Houthi-Saudi sangharsh, Mecca suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Iran ke 14 tanker naakaabandi todne ko taiyar
items.detail: Kharg Island par 14 se zyada tel tanker taiyar hain, dal aur Iran ka jhanda chadha hai; up-mantri ne naakaabandi ko 'yuddh ka kaam' batakar todne ki chetavni di, abhi kafila rawana hone ki swatantra pushti nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Iran-America yuddh, Hormuz, tel naakaabandi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Eisenkot ne Netanyahu se gathbandhan vaarta shuru ki
items.detail: Israel me sarkar banane ki zimmedari wale Gadi Eisenkot ne Netanyahu ki Likud party ko gathbandhan vaarta ke liye bulaya; vaarta ravivaar se shuru hogi, unke paas December tak ka samay hai.
items.exam_angle: Israel sarkar-gathan, Netanyahu — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump: Iran samjhota 'sthayi' hona chahiye
items.detail: Trump ne kaha Iran se koi bhi samjhota sthayi hona chahiye aur Tehran ko parmanu hathiyar banane se rokna chahiye; unhone kaha America aisa sauda nahi manega jisme Iran ke paas parmanu kshamata bache.
items.exam_angle: Iran parmanu karyakram, America — UPSC IR

items.headline: Dakshin Korea ke shiksha mantri ne istifa diya
items.detail: Shiksha mantri Choi Kyo-jin ne AI se cheating rokne ki taiyari me hui gadbad ki zimmedari lete hue istifa diya; Rashtrapati Lee ne turant manzoor kiya, pariksha me electronic device se 111 gadbad ke mamle mile.
items.exam_angle: Pariksha me AI cheating, Suneung — UPSC Ethics/Tech

items.headline: Indonesia candy factory me aag, 39 lapata
items.detail: Jakarta ke paas Serang ki Fonusa Agung Mulia candy factory me shanivaar dopahar aag lagi, 39 log lapata hain aur talash jaari hai; chaar ghayal hue, kuchh hisso me aag abhi bhi jal rahi hai.

items.headline: EU-Indonesia vyapar samjhauta, 10 saal baad
items.detail: EU aur Indonesia ne 10 saal ki baatchit ke baad mukt vyapar samjhauta (CEPA) aur nivesh suraksha samjhauta sign kiya; 90% se zyada utpadon par shulk khatm hoga, 2027 se lagu hone ki ummeed hai.
items.exam_angle: EU ke vyapar samjhote, Bharat-EU FTA — UPSC IR

items.headline: Bangladesh me hinsa: Narail me ghar jalaye
items.detail: Bangladesh me rajnaitik hinsa jaari hai: Narail me BNP netaon ki hatya ke baad darjanon ghar aur dukanein jalayi gayin, Pabna me bhi jhadap hui; pichhle hafte chaar log mare gaye.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh rajnaitik sankat, Bharat sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: COP31 draft me 'fossil fuels' shabd nahi
items.detail: Antalya me COP31 ke antim masaude me 'fossil fuels', tel ya koyla ka zikr hi nahi — 2035 tak bijli ki hissedari 35% ka lakshya hai, aur masaude me pehli baar 1.5°C paar hone ki chinta jatai gayi; manzoori par baatchit jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu samjhauta, 1.5°C — UPSC Environment

items.headline: Iran yuddh par America ka kharch $48.3 billion
items.detail: Pentagon ne Congress ko bataya 13 November tak Iran yuddh par $48.3 billion kharch hue — hathiyar aur sanchalan shamil hain, thikanon ki marammat ka kharch isme nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Iran yuddh ki lagat, America — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Iran ka F-16 dava, America ne nakara
items.detail: Iran ne dava kiya uski vayu raksha ne Farsi ki Khadi me US F-16 ko nishana banaya; US Central Command ne ise 'false report' batakar kharij kiya, saare jet surakshit hain.
items.exam_angle: Iran-America yuddh, F-16 dava — UPSC IR

items.headline: Indonesia candy factory me aag, 39 lapata
items.detail: Jakarta ke paas Serang ki Fonusa Agung Mulia candy factory me shanivaar dopahar aag lagi — teen mare, 36 lapata hain aur talash jaari hai; chaar ghayal hue, kuchh hisso me aag abhi bhi jal rahi hai. (Updated)

items.headline: Hormuz me do tanker par hamla
items.detail: UKMTO ne bataya Shanivar ko Hormuz jaladmaru-madhya me do tanker par agyaat projectile se hamla hua — ek ki stern, doosre ke engine room par; koi ghayal nahi hua. Iran ne ek tanker ke mine se takrane ka dava kiya, jiski swatantra pushti nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Strait of Hormuz, tel vyapar, Iran-America yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Khartoum me drone hamle, ghar tabah
items.detail: Ravivaar subah Sudan ki rajdhani Khartoum me drone hamle hue — subah 2 baje se 4:30 tak dhamake hote rahe, kai ghar tabah ho gaye; abhi tak koi hatahat ki khabar nahi hai. Sudan sena ne hawai raksha sakriya kar di, hamle ke peeche kaun hai ye abhi saaf nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Sudan grih yuddh, drone yuddh, manaviya sankat — UPSC IR

items.headline: Iran ke tel dalalon par America ka pratibandh
items.detail: US Treasury ne chaar Iraniyon par pratibandh lagaya — ve Iran ke tel ki videsh bikri se arbon dollar vasool kar rahe the; unki sampatti jabt hogi aur dollar len-den band. Ye kadam Operation Economic Outcast ke tahat uthaya gaya.
items.exam_angle: Iran par pratibandh, Operation Economic Outcast, tel vyapar — UPSC IR

items.headline: El Chapo Isidro ki giraftari me 11 mare
items.detail: Sinaloa ke Guasave me cartel neta Fausto Isidro Meza Flores ki giraftari ke dauran hui hinsa me 11 log mare — saat sandigdh bandukdhari aur chaar sipahi; use Mexico City le jaya gaya hai.
items.exam_angle: Mexico drug cartel, FBI most-wanted, America-Mexico — UPSC IR
